breakdown.description: Tip boundary condition is inconsistent: an adiabatic tip implies zero heat flux at the tip, so a convective-tip model should not be used.
breakdown.reason: The original prompt was contradictory, stating the fin has an adiabatic tip but then asking to use a convective-tip formula. The ground truth resolves this by clarifying that the adiabatic-tip fin solution should be used. The agent failed to correct this; instead, it doubled down on the incorrect part of the prompt, explicitly instructing to use the convective-tip formula and ignoring the 'adiabatic tip' condition entirely. This is the direct opposite of the ground truth's resolution.
